Sponsors & partners

Partners

Sponsors and institutional partners make it possible to run GRC at no cost to most participants, across more than 150 countries.

Why partner with GRC

Partnering with GRC puts your organization in front of motivated students and educators worldwide, while directly funding financial aid, free teacher resources, and the technical infrastructure that keeps the competition free to enter at the Qualification Round.

How funding is used

Partner and sponsor contributions, together with the Semi-Final Round registration fee, cover problem development, the online exam and supervision platform, certificate production and shipping, and financial aid for participants who need it.

Interested in partnering?

Reach out through the Contact page and let us know a little about your organization — we will follow up with partnership tiers and benefits.
